title: Levant
html:
Levant is an Asian map added to OpenFront in Update 33.0 by RickD004 — Three landmasses surrounding Cyprus in the middle.

Nations

The map features 15 named nations, including Fatimid Caliphate, Kingdom of Jerusalem, County of Tripoli, Principality of Antioch, County of Edessa and Kingdom of Cyprus.
